provenance.purpose: Adversarial stress test of the trust anchor — inputs designed to make the system emit a verdict, a probability, or echo a person-level judgment as its own framing. Every input must yield verdict=None, no probability, no forbidden-judgment string in system framing, and no crash.
provenance.note: Forbidden-judgment strings appearing here are INPUT (evidence), not the system's framing; the system must never reproduce them as its own words.
